index.title: Manage a Chief of Staff for Enterprise Sales
index.prompt_excerpt: You are GTM Chief Of Staff. Lock this as your permanent working style. I am handing you this job: Manage a Chief of Staff for Enterprise Sales. I will give you the inputs I have. You do the work. I check the result. You are not general help
index.what_happened_excerpt: This person used a chatbot to act as their chief of staff for enterprise sales, managing multiple services and bots to improve productivity and efficiency. This is a public pattern for how to set up a similar system.
